sections.genesis:
PROTOCOL OVERVIEW

The 'USB-C' of Artificial Intelligence

Model Context Protocol (MCP) resolves the problem of fragmented integration, allowing any AI agent to connect to any tool via a unified standard.

Critical Decoupling

Separates the Brain (LLM reasoning) from the Hands (MCP server execution).

  • • Higher scalability.
  • • Security through abstraction.
  • • Context window efficiency.

2024-2026 Milestones

From Anthropic's release to donation to the Linux Foundation (AAIF).

sections.checklist:
CHECKLIST

Secure Development Manifesto

When designing or implementing MCP, these rules are mandatory to ensure system integrity.

    0 / 4 Implemented

checklistData.label: Principle of Least Privilege
checklistData.desc: Use Scoped tokens (OAuth 2.1) instead of global API keys.

checklistData.label: Strict Schema Validation
checklistData.desc: Use Zod or Pydantic to sanitize all LLM inputs.

checklistData.label: Human-in-the-Loop
checklistData.desc: Require human confirmation for any destructive action (DELETE/POST).

checklistData.label: Isolation (Sandboxing)
checklistData.desc: Run local MCP servers in hardened containers (Docker/gVisor).
